newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy shares end down but off lows, ENI supports.
newsitem.headline: Italy shares end down but off lows, ENI supports.

text.p: Italian stocks ended easier but rose off session lows in late trading on Tuesday, helped by strong rises in New York and London and with sentiment supported by a good performance from energy giant ENI ahead of its third tranche share sale.
Dealers said the session had again been fairly gloomy with worries over a delay to the single European currency. But Fib bourse index futures were firm and Btp bond futures perkier.
The All share Mibtel index ended down 0.25 percent at 12,134 after a low at 12,072 and the Mib30 blue chip index closed off 0.21 percent at 18,183 after a 19,065 low.
ENI closed 1.14 percent higher at 8,960 lire in volume of over 18 million shares

In heavily traded and weak telecoms, savings shares in Telecom Italia and Stet holding company, which crashed on Monday after the Treasury announced there would be no conversion into ordinary stock, were again very feeble after an early rebound.
Many foreign investors had bet heavily on a conversion ahead of the privatisation of Stet which the government said will now go ahead by October.
Telecom Italia ordinary shares were off 1.77 percent at 4,555 lire and Stet ordinary down 1.47 percent at 8,420.
Fiat, which saw Italian new car sales rise in May year-on-year but were down from April this year, lost 0.74 percent to 5,792 lire amid gloom over a market slowdown.
Shares in food group Parmalat rose 0.91 percent to 2,332 lire as investors warmed to the Italian group's bid for Canada's Ault Foods.
Luxury goods group and jeweller Bulgari, seen close to be making an acquisition in the luxury goods sector, put on 1.52 percent to 9,258 lire.
Financial holding group Gemina ended 3.76 percent higher at 603.9 and clothing group Benetton rose 2.84 percent to 23,487 lire.
